mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b JOIN tutor_availability ta ON b.availability_id = ta.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND ta.start_at >= NOW() AND b.canceled_at IS NULL) AS upcomingLessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b JOIN tutor_availability ta ON b.availability_id = ta.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND ta.start_at < NOW()) AS completedLessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r JOIN booking b ON r.booking_id = b.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId}) AS totalReviews, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN booking b ON p.booking_id = b.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'PAID'), 0) AS totalSpent

SELECT b.id AS bookingId, l.id AS lessonId, COALESCE(l.user_id, ta.user_id) AS tutorId, COALESCE(u.name, tu.name) AS tutorName, COALESCE(l.title, b.title) AS subject, ta.start_at AS startAt, ta.end_at AS endAt, CASE WHEN b.canceled_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN b.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status, COALESCE(l.price, 0) AS price FROM booking b JOIN tutor_availability ta ON b.availability_id = ta.id LEFT JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id LEFT JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users tu ON ta.user_id = tu.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND ta.start_at >= NOW() AND b.canceled_at IS NULL ORDER BY ta.start_at ASC

SELECT b.id AS bookingId, l.id AS lessonId, COALESCE(l.user_id, ta.user_id) AS tutorId, COALESCE(u.name, tu.name) AS tutorName, COALESCE(l.title, b.title) AS subject, ta.start_at AS startAt, ta.end_at AS endAt, CASE WHEN b.canceled_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END AS status, COALESCE(l.price, 0) AS price FROM booking b JOIN tutor_availability ta ON b.availability_id = ta.id LEFT JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id LEFT JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users tu ON ta.user_id = tu.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND ta.start_at < NOW() ORDER BY ta.start_at DESC

SELECT r.id AS reviewId, l.user_id AS tutorId, u.name AS tutorName, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM review r JOIN booking b ON r.booking_id = b.id JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
